findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The description "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" does not specify which facilities, equipment, duration of provision or standards for the site setup, which violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (clear and exhaustive description).
findings.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., temporary offices, storage, sanitation), quantities, standards (DIN 18363), and the period of provision.

findings.title: Potential risk transfer for site usage
findings.message: The term "vorhalten" may shift the risk of maintaining the site beyond the construction phase to the contractor without a clear contractual basis, which can be ineffective under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Define the exact period of site provision and any additional compensation for extended usage.

findings.title: Missing disposal specifications
findings.message: The text does not state the type of waste, classification, required transport distance, or the specific licensed disposal site, which are mandatory technical specifications according to STLB‑Bau.
findings.suggestion: Add waste classification (e.g., B3), maximum transport distance, and name of the approved landfill.

findings.title: Insufficient details for shaft construction
findings.message: Only "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" is given; missing height, wall thickness, reinforcement, connection details and required tolerances, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Specify shaft depth, segment dimensions, concrete class, reinforcement layout, and installation tolerances.

findings.title: Missing concrete exposure and performance data
findings.message: The description lacks exposure class, slump, required curing, and reinforcement details, which are required by DIN EN 206 and VOB/C § 4.2 for concrete works.
findings.suggestion: Add exposure class (e.g., XC4), slump range, curing period, and reinforcement specifications.

findings.title: Missing mortar and reinforcement data for masonry
findings.message: Only "Kalksandsteinmauerwerk nach statischer Vorgabe" is stated; the mortar type, bond, and any required reinforcement are not defined, contrary to STLB‑Bau requirements.
findings.suggestion: Specify mortar class (e.g., M 7.5), bond length, and reinforcement if required.

findings.title: Insufficient interior plaster specifications
findings.message: The description does not define plaster material class, minimum thickness, surface preparation or drying time, which are mandatory technical data.
findings.suggestion: Add plaster class (e.g., P 1), thickness (e.g., ≥ 10 mm), and substrate preparation requirements.

findings.title: Missing technical data for cement screed
findings.message: No information on screed thickness, water‑cement ratio, curing regime or reinforcement is provided, which is required for CT‑C25‑F4 according to DIN 18560.
findings.suggestion: State screed thickness (e.g., 45 mm), w/c ratio, curing time, and any reinforcement mesh.

findings.title: Lack of details for underground waterproofing
findings.message: The text "Abdichtung gemäß geltenden technischen Regeln" does not specify the waterproofing system (e.g., bitumen sheet, fluid membrane), class, or water pressure resistance, which are required by VOB/C § 4.2 and DIN 18195.
findings.suggestion: Define the waterproofing material, class (e.g., W‑K2), and applicable installation standards.

findings.title: Missing specifications for paving slab
findings.message: No details on stone type, size, joint width, or laying method are given, which are required for a complete specification under VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Specify stone class (e.g., B 2), dimensions, joint width (e.g., 3 mm), and laying technique.

findings.title: Insufficient data for asphalt base layer
findings.message: The description lacks gradation, binder content, and temperature specifications required by DIN 18341 for asphalt base courses.
findings.suggestion: Add required gradation (e.g., G 2‑3), binder content (e.g., 5 % bitumen), and laying temperature range.

findings.title: Missing technical parameters for asphalt wearing course
findings.message: No information on surface class, thickness, or aggregate type is provided, which is necessary under DIN 18341 and VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Specify surface class (e.g., AC 16), minimum thickness (e.g., 30 mm), and aggregate specifications.
